title: L'imparfait – Online Test
desc: Forming and using the imperfect tense: nous-stem + endings, irregular verbs, être, perfect vs imperfect. 7 sections, auto-marked, with a Fix-it correction round.

title: Slip test 1 – Guided paper
desc: Class paper with the idea maps and videos for both letters, a tap-for-meaning comprehension with guidance on how to answer, and every grammar rule explained. Model answers unlock student by student.

title: Slip test 2 – Guided paper
desc: Second class paper with idea maps and narrated videos for both letters, two tap-for-meaning comprehension texts, three verb exercises with a Step 1 table, and every grammar rule explained. Model answers unlock student by student.

title: Slip test 3 – Grammar paper
desc: Class grammar paper (40 marks) with every rule explained under each question and a short 1–3 minute mini-lesson video for each grammar point. Model answers unlock student by student.
